cc:Work.dc:title: CellPack random-order loading throughput
cc:Work.dc:description: Technical report sections 5.1-5.2, Figure 5. One NVMe SSD, 16 workers, global random order. Baselines: best variant per method at 20 GB cache, means over three seeds, 60 s post-warm-up windows, sample output. CellPack: 0 data cache, direct I/O, report-selected value for a single 5 s check after a warm-up epoch, no variance estimate; 9967232 cells from 430 datasets, fixed 2048-gene float32 output (8192 bytes/cell). These are different output paths and timing protocols, not an identical-output speedup comparison. CellPack paper values replace interference-affected exports; see the note in cellpack_paper_values.json.
